problem_statement: During RCP recovery, SpinelDriver::ProcessFrameQueue() can continue iterating saved receive frames after the receive buffer has been cleared. The saved-frame callback can trigger RecoverFromRcpFailure(), which clears the buffer and waits for responses. New notifications received during those waits may be saved before the callback returns. Continuing with the old frame cursor can then interpret stale bytes or bytes in the replacement frames as a frame header, causing invalid lengths and an out-of-bounds read. Reproduce this using MultiFrameBuffer's public API: save multiple frames, start iterating, clear or compact the buffer, save replacement frames, then continue the original iteration. The invalidated iteration must terminate with OT_ERROR_NOT_FOUND, a null frame pointer, and zero length. A new iteration must still retrieve the replacement frames correctly. Normal iteration, skip lengths, appending frames during iteration, and discarding the current unsaved frame must continue to work.
